title: Taxes and fees
summary: Entrance fees are recorded on each attraction only when a source exists. This page does not quote a tax rate. Where a fee is missing, the attraction says check on arrival.

sections.heading: What is listed
paragraphs: An attraction page states a fee when that fee is already in the record. Otherwise it says check on arrival. Do not treat a blank as zero.
Shop prices and hotel bills can include tax. This guide does not state a percentage. Read the bill, or ask before you pay.

faqs.q: Where is the visitor tax rate?
faqs.a: It is not quoted here. Confirm the charge on the bill or at the gate.

seoDescription: How Vietnam Guide records entrance fees. No tax rate is quoted.
